newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Greencore says acquires control of Kears.
newsitem.headline: Greencore says acquires control of Kears.

text.p: Greencore Group Plc said on Monday that it had acquired control of Kears Group by increasing its interest in the company to 98.5 percent from 49.99 percent for a consideration of 25.2 million sterling.
This will be satisfied by the issue of 10 million sterling in fixed rate loan notes while 10 million sterling will be raised through the issue of Greencore ordinary shares with the balance in cash.
The remaining shares in Kears will be held by executive management subject to arrangements for Greencore to acquire these shares over a five-year period, the company said in a statement.
Kears, a British baking group, reported operating profits of 7.37 million sterling on sales of 82.7 million in the year ended September 28, 1996
Greencore first took a 20 percent stake in Kears in 1990, increasing this to 30 percent in 1991 and 49.99 percent in 1995.
